patch_description: Replace the static enemy-risk route potential with four forecast horizons and backward dynamic programming. Route values then account for when the agent reaches a threatened cell, including the option to wait for danger to pass. Target selection uses estimated arrival times; longer routes relax toward a background occupancy estimate. Reuse second-step forecasts and pool later forecasts to bound computation. Preserve the existing learner, exported next-step predictions, and conditional immediate collision calculations. This is an untested control improvement motivated by the supplied arrival-aware routing results.
